t: 忽必烈可汗的蒙古分舰队被"神风"所摧毁,第二次被克安之战所摧毁.
te: The Mongolian fleet of Kublai Khan is destroyed by a "divine wind" for the second time in the Battle of Kōan.
dz: 蒙古入侵日本:忽必烈可汗的蒙古分舰队被"神风"所摧毁,第二次被克安之战所摧毁.
de: Mongol invasions of Japan: The Mongolian fleet of Kublai Khan is destroyed by a "divine wind" for the second time in the Battle of Kōan.
